Namespaces.Name: IntegrationBanks
Namespaces.Doc: Runtime settings for SoundBank loading and location.

Options.Name: IsAutoBankEnabled
Options.Doc: Whether Auto Bank is enabled in Wwise.

Options.Name: LoadBanksAsynchronously
Options.Doc: Default settings for loading banks. This setting can be overriden by each bank.

Options.Name: SoundBanksBasePath
Options.Doc: Path for the SoundBanks. This must contain one sub folder per platform, with the same as in the Wwise project.

Options.Name: SoundBankPersistentDataPath
Options.Doc: Sets the sub-folder underneath UnityEngine.Application.persistentDataPath that will be used as the SoundBank base path. This is useful when the Init.bnk needs to be downloaded. Setting this to an empty string uses the typical SoundBank base path resolution. Setting this to "." uses UnityEngine.Application.persistentDataPath.

Namespaces.Name: IntegrationFocusLoss
Namespaces.Doc: Runtime settings applied when the editor or game loses focus.

Options.Name: RenderDuringFocusLoss
Options.Doc: Determines whether to continue rendering audio while audio is suspended during focus loss. Only applicable if Suspend Audio During Focus Loss is enabled.

Options.Name: SuspendAudioDuringFocusLoss
Options.Doc: Determines whether to suspend audio during loss of focus of the editor or game.

Namespaces.Name: IntegrationLogging
Namespaces.Doc: Runtime settings for Wwise engine and integration logging.

Options.Name: IsEngineLoggingEnabled
Options.Doc: Enable Wwise engine logging. This is used to turn on/off the logging of the Wwise engine.

Options.Name: WwiseLoggerLevel
Options.Doc: Verbosity of the Wwise Unity integration logger. We recommend using at least the Error level when building your project; setting this to None can cause builds to succeed with silent Wwise failures.

AllowedValues.Doc: Silence all logs. Note: This will cause builds to pass, even if Wwise has errors.

Namespaces.Name: Integration
Namespaces.Doc: Runtime settings for the Wwise Unity integration

Options.Name: DefaultListenerScalingFactor
Options.Doc: The default value of the "Attenuation Scaling Factor" when an AkAudioListener is created.
